meta.name: discover
meta.description: Trace a customer workflow and identify the problem, baseline and evidence gaps. Use for discovery or an unclear customer brief, before choosing a solution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理模糊的客户需求,找出真正的问题、现状基线和缺失的证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户只丢来一句模糊需求,你还不知道该做什么方案
copy.tagline_en: Trace a vague customer brief into the real problem, its baseline, and the evidence gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a client hands you a fuzzy brief and you don't yet know what to build

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 discover 方法追踪客户的工作流,识别其中的问题、基线和证据缺口,并如实标出未知项和尚未运行的检查。
howto.when: 当处于发现阶段、客户简报不清楚,或在选定方案之前需要先摸清工作流时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我追踪这个客户的工作流,找出问题和证据缺口
say.note: 会按方法逐步梳理并标注未知项

say.text: 客户简报不清楚,先做一轮发现再谈方案
把当前基线记下来,并说明哪些还没验证
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude traces a customer workflow per the discover method, identifies the problem, baseline and evidence gaps, and flags unknowns honestly.
howto.when_en: It takes over during discovery, with an unclear customer brief, or before choosing a solution while the workflow is still being mapped.

say_en.text: Trace this customer's workflow and find the problem and evidence gaps
say_en.note: Walks through it step by step and flags unknowns

say_en.text: The brief is unclear - run discovery before choosing a solution
say_en.note: Clarifies the problem and baseline first

say_en.text: Record the current baseline and say what is still unverified
